about: Wordless (instrumental) original radio songs for the in-car radio programme. Prompts describe genre traits only; they never name an artist, song, band, game or composer. Each song is rendered text-to-music with ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo through the committed workflow, two candidates per song (seed and seed+1); tool/audio/radiokit picks one and masters it.
licence: ACE-Step 1.5 weights Apache-2.0 (user-approved 2026-11); generated audio is original to this project
common_tags: instrumental, no vocals, no singing, wordless, upbeat, driving road trip energy, high quality stereo studio mix
